whatIFly.title: What I fly
whatIFly.description: Each toolkit turns on by itself from your licences, ratings, aircraft and flights. Set it yourself to keep it on, turn it off, or mark what you are training toward.
whatIFly.noEvidence: No licence, rating, aircraft or flight for this toolkit yet.
whatIFly.noneActive: No toolkit is on yet, so NinerLog shows everything. Turn on what you fly or train for.
whatIFly.showEverythingHelp: Turns folding off: every field, card and report is shown, whatever your toolkits say. With it off, features for toolkits you don't use fold into a “More” section on the same screen. Nothing is ever deleted or hidden for good, and anything that holds data is always shown.
whatIFly.loadError: Your toolkits could not be loaded, so NinerLog shows everything.
whatIFly.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
